2.en: The servants of the Inquisition do not always agree on the value of unity. Some factions, particularly the Radical Isstvanians, believe in strife over cooperation as a means of shepherding strength. However, even Isstvanian cells cannot operate wholly alone and must turn to nominally trusted allies for difficult tasks. The Group Endeavours in this section include tasks that cannot be completed by any single character alone. 94.en: Innocence Proves Nothing. The Inquisition has never tolerated ideas such as the need to prove guilt of a crime or to spare punishment of those whose status is merely free of a particular sin as anything more than spurious weakness. Even if a citizen of the Imperium is not the heretic they seek, any Inquisitor hardened enough to bear the rosette would still prefer them as a casualty to excessive zeal than a future weakness in the Imperium’s armour. So it is that whole cities have been rounded up for torment and questioning to no avail, then brutally executed to prevent the possibility that the survivors would seek revenge or rebellion.

For every character who was successful during this Endeavour, successful Presence Tests made before the next downtime period have their SLs increased by 1 as the population sets themselves to unquestioning obedience. However, should a character be known to have participated in this Endeavour, all Rapport (Charm) Tests with those they have oppressed are at Disadvantage. Unlike the compliance of the populace, this penalty lasts indefinitely unless the GM rules that the character manages to impress their victims with a righteous display of punishment or a persuasive piece of indoctrination.

122.en: The group’s Inquisitor calls upon other Inquisition forces and prominent acolytes in the area, aiming to pool knowledge in hopes of mutual advantage or to aid in thwarting a particular threat. Inquisitors and their agents are insular by nature. They operate in small cells that communicate little with each other, partly to prevent their network from being compromised by a single cell’s failure but also out of distrust for one another. On occasion, Inquisitors may put aside their paranoia and condescend to meet in person or send representatives to attend in their place.

Они работают небольшими ячейками, что почти не взаимодействуют друг с другом – отчасти потому что тогда провал одной команды не подставит все остальные, но куда больше – из недоверия.
